trigger_condition.shape_trigger: Large last dimension or transformer-like attention shapes, e.g., batch, heads, sequence_length, sequence_length
trigger_condition.dtype_trigger: float16 or bfloat16 input; comparing default low-precision softmax against explicit dtype=torch.float32 followed by cast to low precision
trigger_condition.value_trigger: Normal random values, large magnitude values, values with small differences
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: Compare torch.softmax(x, dim) with torch.softmax(x, dim, dtype=torch.float32).to(x.dtype)

root_cause.api_layer: torch.softmax dtype argument exposes different internal precision paths for low-precision inputs
root_cause.kernel_layer: CUDA softmax kernel may use different accumulation paths for default float16 and explicit float32 dtype
root_cause.numerical_layer: float16 precision loss and accumulation order differences produce small numerical inconsistencies

bug_oracle.description: torch.softmax on fp16 input and torch.softmax with dtype=torch.float32 followed by cast to fp16 produce different results.
bug_oracle.signal: max absolute difference exceeds tolerance threshold

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Mutate dtype between float16 and bfloat16; mutate reduction dimension and tensor shape; mutate values with normal random, large magnitude, and small-difference distributions.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct CUDA low-precision tensors with large reduction dimensions and transformer-like attention shapes, e.g., batch, heads, sequence_length, sequence_length.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Inject explicit dtype=torch.float32 softmax computation and cast back to the original low-precision dtype for comparison.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Compute y0 = torch.softmax(x, dim=-1); compute y1 = torch.softmax(x, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32).to(x.dtype); compare y0 and y1.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Use max absolute difference or allclose with dtype-appropriate tolerances; fail when numerical difference exceeds threshold.
